notes.title: Development’s on Track!
notes.content: [p]Hello librarians! 🧙‍♂️📚[/p][p]Development on [i]The Librarian[/i] is moving along nicely, and today I’d like to share a broader look at where the project is heading.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🗺️ Feature Map[/b][/h2][p]I’ve created a [b]feature map[/b] that outlines the game’s main themes: core mechanics, progression, UI, content, atmosphere…[/p][p]Each item is color-coded to indicate its current status. The goal is to give you a clear view of the game’s progress — even when what I’m working on isn’t very visual yet.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]📌 Why a feature map?[/b][/h3][p]Not everything can be shown in a screenshot — some updates are technical, invisible, but absolutely essential.[/p][p]This feature map helps communicate those behind-the-scenes elements, without waiting for everything to be screen-worthy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544642/fe7991e5ed0d0d791171ac33ad1fbf786d711db7.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]🔧 Recent additions[/b][/h2][p]Here are the latest major features I’ve been working on:[/p][p][/p][h3]📚 [b]Dynamic reader flow system[/b][/h3][p]Readers no longer arrive at random. Their visits now follow a [b]curve of activity[/b] based on the time of day, with peaks and quiet periods. It brings a real sense of rhythm to your days in the library![/p][p][/p][h3]✨ [b]Progression through magic schools[/b][/h3][p]I’ve implemented rules for progressing in each school of magic. The [b]prestige[/b] of a school in your library now determines the new content you unlock: books, decorations, new types of readers…[/p][p]This is the core engine of your expansion as a librarian.[/p][p][/p][h3]⏱️ [b]Game speed control[/b][/h3][p]A speed controller is now available to let you [b]fast-forward[/b] time when things are under control. Perfect for breezing through calm periods or managing your flow more efficiently![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]📝 Development is still in full swing, and your support is invaluable. [/p][p]If you haven’t already, don’t forget to [b]wishlist the game[/b] — it really helps me as a solo dev! Playable versions will come once the core gameplay loop is ready.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 Wishlist now to follow the journey:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3565110/The_Librarian"][/dynamiclink]Thanks again for being here — and see you soon in the library! 🧙‍♂️📚[/p]

notes.title: A Fresh Look & the First Magical Tomes
notes.content:
Hello librarians! 🧙‍♂️📚

This last weeks, I’ve been working on a full UI overhaul to make your librarian life smoother, clearer — and just a bit more magical. You’ll now notice a revamped bookshelf view, a cleaner inventory, and a compact display of reader requests directly in the HUD.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544642/4d74027b9b2e1155696c7ac95852e50c31c35bcd.png[/img]

Everything is designed to help you focus on what matters most: managing a chaotic magical library and keeping your readers satisfied.

📚 I’ve also started adding the very first books to the game!
For now, you’ll only find a few from two magical schools: Pyromancy and Hydromancy. But don’t worry — many more schools of magic are coming soon, each with its own flavor, quirks, and surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544642/e771bf5418cafe6b71449086f9af3dac7411ea72.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544642/538ee95baab3d1c92d75924bd0c7cb328b2bafd5.png[/img]

This is just the beginning of the library’s collection, and I can’t wait to show you what else is waiting behind the shelves.

📝 I’m still hard at work building this world, and your support means a lot.
If you haven’t yet, don’t forget to wishlist the game — it helps me tremendously as a solo dev!

Development is still in progress, and early playable versions will come as soon as the core loop is ready.

👉 Wishlist now and follow the journey: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3565110/The_Librarian

Thanks for being here — and see you in the library! 🧙‍♂️📚

notes.title: The Librarian is evolving – Wishlist it now!
notes.content:
Hello librarians! 🧙‍♂️📚

We’re taking a [b]major step forward[/b] — The Librarian is no longer just a quick arcade-style experience. The game is evolving into [b]a full magical library simulation[/b]!

The original version of The Librarian was a short, time-based solo game inspired by Overcooked: deliver spellbooks, beat the timer, and don’t mess up your enchantments!

But now, we’re shifting gears. Here’s what’s changing:

You’ll play as the full-time librarian of a magical archive. Your job is to bring the right spellbooks to your wizard customers — but only if they’re allowed to access them. Some spells are dangerous, some customers are unpredictable, and magic doesn’t always behave.

The gameplay now focuses on [b]long-term management[/b], [b]reputation[/b], and [b]progression[/b]. As your library grows, you’ll unlock new books, meet regular clients, handle magical incidents, and expand your space with new rooms and furniture.

Visually, the game [b]moves to 3D environments with a fixed camera, while keeping 2D pixel art characters[/b]. It’s a stylized blend that brings atmosphere and charm, especially with the day-night cycle in motion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544642/e62ed41e6391a98283dcdf3e06e210d593dbfe3f.gif[/img]

Development is still in progress, and early playable versions will come as soon as the core loop is ready.

👉 Wishlist now and follow the journey: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3565110/The_Librarian

Thanks for being here — and see you in the library! 🧙‍♂️📚
